title: GO:1905523: UMAP of k-sep. bigram PSSM
caption: UMAP projection of all 268 proteins in the GO:1905523 pool, described by k-sep. bigram PSSM (400 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.12. Axes have no units, and distances between far-apart clusters are not meaningful. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
